cases.title: Select All functionality checks all individual checkboxes and updates label to 全不选
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Select All/None' checkbox (data-testid 'checkAll') when unchecked checks all individual checkboxes ('checkbox-1' to 'checkbox-10') and updates the label (data-testid 'checkAll-label') to '全不选'.

cases.title: Select None functionality unchecks all individual checkboxes and updates label to 全选
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Select All/None' checkbox when all individual checkboxes are checked deselects all of them and updates the label (data-testid 'checkAll-label') to '全选'.

cases.title: Partial individual checkbox selection keeps Select All unchecked with label 全选
cases.description: Verify that when some but not all individual checkboxes are selected, the 'Select All/None' checkbox remains unchecked and its label displays '全选'.

cases.title: Manual selection of all individual checkboxes automatically updates master control
cases.description: Verify that manually checking all individual checkboxes ('checkbox-1' to 'checkbox-10') one by one automatically checks the 'Select All/None' checkbox and updates its label to '全不选'.

cases.title: Reverse Selection link inverts state of all individual checkboxes and updates master UI
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Reverse Selection' link (data-testid 'checkReverse') inverts the checked state of each individual checkbox ('checkbox-1' to 'checkbox-10') regardless of initial mixed/uniform states, and updates the 'Select All/None' checkbox and label accordingly.

analysis.analysis:
e2edev_bench_57-R-1: Testable behaviors include clicking the 'Select All/None' checkbox (data-testid='checkAll') to toggle checkboxes ('checkbox-1' to 'checkbox-10'), verifying label (data-testid='checkAll-label') updates between '全不选' and '全选', manual toggling of individual checkboxes updating the master control, and using 'Reverse Selection' (data-testid='checkReverse') to invert states and update the master control. Boundaries: exactly 10 individual checkboxes. Normal paths: master checked sets all child checkboxes to checked and label to '全不选'; master unchecked sets all child checkboxes to unchecked and label to '全选'; reverse selection inverts each child state. Abnormal/Ambiguous paths: partial selection state sets master to unchecked and label to '全选'. 

e2edev_bench_57-R-2: Testable behaviors include clicking 'Select All/None' to switch states and labels. Boundaries: handling all selected vs. any deselected state. Normal paths: if all selected, clicking deselects all and sets label to '全选'; if any deselected, clicking selects all and sets label to '全不选'. Interdependence between individual checkboxes and collective state/label is required. 

e2edev_bench_57-R-3: Testable behaviors include clicking the 'Reverse Selection' link (data-testid='checkReverse') to invert each checkbox state ('checkbox-1' to 'checkbox-10'). Boundaries: initial states can be all checked, all unchecked, or mixed. Normal paths: checked items become unchecked, unchecked items become checked. 

e2edev_bench_57-R-4: Testable behaviors include dynamic updates of 'checkAll' and 'checkAll-label' based on child states. Specific conditions: 1) All selected -> 'checkAll' checked, label '全不选'. 2) None selected -> 'checkAll' unchecked, label '全选'. 3) Some selected -> 'checkAll' unchecked, label '全选'. 'Reverse Selection' ('checkReverse') triggers state inversion with UI synchronization. Ambiguities: handling edge cases like toggling already selected or unselected individual checkboxes.
